Mandate Timeline

Regulatory Updates

Chronological compliance schedules, technical specifications, and key rollout phases dictated by the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) and Oman Tax Authority (OTA).

Q2 2024

PEPPOL Authority Declaration

UAE FTA announces adoption of PEPPOL as the foundation for the national e-invoicing model.

Q4 2024

PINT AE Spec Release

Release of PEPPOL PINT AE (UAE specifications) and local Schematron business rules.

Q2 2025

Service Provider Accreditations

FTA begins accrediting Access Point providers (ASPs) for the local market.

Dec 2025

Phase 1 Mandate Go-Live

Mandatory B2B & B2G e-invoicing compliance for large tax groups and enterprise sellers.

2026

Phase 2 Mandate Expansion

Gradual onboarding of mid-market and SME taxpayers into the PEPPOL network.
